dedupe_keys.name: eu 27 country mapping of financing schemes to decarbonize buildings heating and cooling

description: A Zenodo deposit maps public and private financing instruments for decarbonising buildings, heating and cooling across the EU-27. The public CC BY 4.0 XLSX is divided into public and private scheme sheets. The provider says each row identifies country, administrative level, names in English and local languages, directly or indirectly covered sectors, instrument type, links, a short description and page-visit date. Socioeconomic, climate and energy indicators and a correlation matrix are also included. These policy inputs could parameterise financing availability or adoption constraints in building-retrofit and district-heat planning simulations. The workbook is a time-sensitive map of schemes, not proof that a current applicant qualifies or that funds remain open. The own page does not state a consistent effective date for all instruments or independent checks of eligibility rules. Each original scheme has its own conditions beyond this dataset licence. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this EU-wide mapping. The spreadsheet was not downloaded, so row count and current links remain unchecked.
